preconditions.description: The lengths of permutations a and b satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: Permutation a is a sequence of n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= m for x in b) and len(set(b)) == m
preconditions.description: Permutation b is a sequence of m distinct integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(len({d for d in range(-10**6, 10**6 + 1) if all((x + d) in b for x in a)}))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct integers d such that the sequence c (where c_i = a_i + d for all i) is a subsequence of b.
